notes.title: Bestiary, Perks, Befriending and More!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Creature Keepers!

Below is an overview of all the changes currently available to tinker with in the public beta version of CK. Anybody can jump in and share their thoughts and ideas! There will be some simple steps to opt in towards the end of this post if you're interested. I'd like to get this update pushed by sometime next week.
[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]General Menu QoL[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]When scrolling down or up when you’re at the edges of menus, the menu will continue scrolling until it reaches the limit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Player Changes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced base dodge time to 1.0 seconds from 2.0 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]You can now increase base dodge time to 2.5 seconds by getting upgrades from the bestiary[/p][/*][*][p]Your dodge buff now includes +50% increased movement speed[/p][/*][*][p]Your dodge invulnerability period is now the same as the length of the dodge buff. Previously it was locked to 1.0 seconds even though the dodge benefits lasted for 2.0 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]The player damage multiplier that was introduced in a previous patch (500%) has been reduced to 400%[/p][/*][*][p]You can now increase the player's damage to effectively 900% with player increases with Bestiary Upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]You can now increase the player's crit multiplier to 200% from Bestiary upgrades. It was locked in at 50% previously[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where everything in the game had -50% crit multiplier. Watch out for back attacks![/p][/*][*][p]The player's crit multiplier is 50% by default, this means they do an additional 50% damage when critting[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the healing from creature hearts by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]You can now increase the amount healed by hearts when petting creatures by +30 with player increases which will scale with creature heart bonuses[/p][/*][*][p]You can now increase your HP to 400 with Bestiary Upgrades
[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Befriending Changes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now use your fruit to grant up to three Innate Perks for creatures you’re befriending![/p][/*][*][p]Innate Perks are permanent stat bonuses[/p][/*][*][p]The fruits that you use influence what innate perks a creature can roll[/p][/*][*][p]A creature’s stat ranks will influence what innate perks they can roll[/p][/*][*][p]A creature cannot have two of the same Innate Perk[/p][/*][*][p]There are descriptions for the rewards that you’re selecting[/p][/*][*][p]You can hover over an Innate Perk to see what it does after you’ve rolled for it[/p][/*][*][p]You start off with being able to select two rewards, which can be increased to 4 as you level up a creature’s Bestiary entry[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards are: Innate Perks, Befriending the Creature, Fruit Trading, Hat Unlocks, Skill Gems[/p][/*][*][p]There are indicators added to help guide how the system works[/p][/*][*][p]You at max need 5 fruits to trade for a reward[/p][/*][*][p]You can see progress towards unlocking a new Bestiary Point in a Bar at the top of the Befriending Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Progress for the Bestiary Point persists between different creatures of the same species[/p][/*][*][p]Filling the bar is not required to befriend the creature anymore. You must select the reward instead at any time[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum rarity of Skill Gem you can get has been lowered to Uncommon (Green). Corrupted creatures still drop rare Skill Gems[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b][u]Perk Changes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]The Perk system has been reworked! Equip as many Perks as your Perk Points allow. Each perk costs an amount of Perk points. You can have more than 4 perks now![/p][/*][*][p]The number of Perk Points you have available is determined by your creature’s level[/p][/*][*][p]At first you will start with no Perks, and rolling an Innate Perk unlocks that same Perk to be equipped with Perk Points[/p][/*][*][p]Innate Perks you get from Befriending creatures are permanent and cannot be removed and also cost nothing [/p][/*][*][p]Creatures from older saves will have their equipped perks converted to Innate Perks[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b][u]Bestiary Changes[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]There are new types of goals set for each creature which grant you Bestiary Points[/p][/*][*][p]Many creatures have more Bestiary rewards that give the player bonuses to become stronger[/p][/*][*][p]You can hover over the Bestiary Goals which gives you hints on how to finish the goal[/p][/*][*][p]Some Bestiary Unlocks have been shuffled around and saves should transfer without issues[/p][/*][*][p]UI has been moved around to make it so that button prompts don’t block text[/p][/*][*][p]If you complete all the Bestiary Goals and don’t have enough points to fill up your constellation, you are given all of the remaining points that you need[/p][/*][*][p]Info I Has a new effect : Allows you to trade fruit with this creature while befriending it.[/p][/*][*][p]Info II Has a new effect : Unlocks a new Innate Perk and an extra reward node choice for creatures you befriend.[/p][/*][*][p]Info IV Has a new effect : Unlocks a new Innate Perk and an extra reward node choice for creatures you befriend.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Trade Reward goal    
[/p][p]
[i][b]Here's a quick guide to opting in to public beta branch!  

[/b][/i]While I encourage everyone to use their preferred channels to share your thoughts, the overall conversation will be held in the discord channel associated with it: [url="https://discord.gg/hf9UZsQ"]discord.gg/hf9UZsQ[/url]

[b]Instructions for accessing the beta build for Creature Keeper
[/b]1.) To start, right click Creature Keeper in your library 
2.) Select Properties in the drop down that opens up  
3.) Select Beta on the left side of the window that pops up  
4.) Enter the code, "[b]ElevatedBepBep[/b]" in the private betas field and press the check code button to get access  
5.) To finish, select the 'staging' beta branch option in the Beta Participation drop down [/p][/*][/list][p]

Looking forward to your input,

Fervir  

[/p]

notes.title: Beta Test Branch is Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Creature Keepers! 

First off, thank you all for your continued support since Creature Keeper's release! I feel joyful in seeing how you all connect with CK, whether it's through bringing a tear to your eye from the story, or through the excitement of putting a silly hat on your favorite creature. 

I've been thinking about how to create more opportunities for that connection, and one way is to introduce a public ⁠beta-branch here on steam, in addition to a dedicated channel for it in the Creature Keeper Discord! The purpose of this is to give me a low-stakes environment where I can upload a version of Creature Keeper which is open to be influenced by your feedback! This feedback will be especially helpful for me as I get into the upcoming perk and bestiary rework systems, making them more fun and as bug-free as possible.

The Test Branch and channel in discord are ready right now, here's a quick guide to opting in to check it out. While I encourage everyone to use their preferred channels to share your thoughts, the overall conversation will be held in the discord channel associated with it: [url="https://discord.gg/hf9UZsQ"]discord.gg/hf9UZsQ[/url]

[b]Instructions for accessing the beta build for Creature Keeper[/b] 
1.) To start, right click Creature Keeper in your library
2.) Select Properties in the drop down that opens up 
3.) Select Beta on the left side of the window that pops up 
4.) Enter the code, "[b]ElevatedBepBep[/b]" in the private betas field and press the check code button to get access 
5.) To finish, select the 'staging' beta branch option in the Beta Participation drop down
[/p][p]
Looking forward to your input,

Fervir  [/p]

notes.title: More Improvements and Fixes, Plus the Push For Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Creature Keepers! Another patch is here, and v1.2.1 is focused on key optimizations that were needed to push for Steam Deck verified and bug fixing some nasty save problems, among other things.

[i][b]General Improvements[/b][/i]

- Added full Cloud Save functionality
[i]Players should now be able to save their games and have their progress transfer between their all their devices, including Steam Deck.[/i]

- Set default Screen Mode to Fullscreen
- Added Multiple Controller support
- Configuration files are now unique to each platform

[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

- (Major Fix) Players should no longer be unable to save upon starting the game for the first time
- fixed issues with a series of missing NPCS during cutscenes
- Fixed an issue with Quest Tracker displaying incorrectly upon receiving a new quest
- Players are now less likely to get stunlocked by a Bep on the Bep Farm map which was causing some softlocks
- Fixed an issue where doors in Hiven Mines were being displayed at the wrong angle
- Fixed typos in Portuguese (BR) regarding sign directions
- Updates to some missing text strings for localization
- Fixed a typo for the Hat Unlock description


While not the most exciting patch, we are committed to making Creature Keeper an enjoyable experience across all the devices we support. With that said, gameplay improvements and balance changes are on the way! As always, we appreciate everyone's support and will continue to make this game the best it can be!

Indie Forever,
Troy

notes.title: Localization Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Localization is here, and with it, a warm welcome to all the new Keepers joining the ranks! We've added Localization for Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, and Spanish! In addition, some bug fixes, and requested changes!

For those with a keen eye, otherwise this can be ignored, you may have noticed we changed how patch version notation is represented, with the goal to be more consistent, and less confusing. (The numbers Mason, what do they mean!?) From v1.014 onward etc, to v1.1.2 where the last number will be the one changing from patch to patch unless it's a large or major update.



[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

-Fixed a series of bugs introduced from v1.014 where NPCs were duplicated, missing from cutscenes, or being incorrectly added to the party

[i][b]Quality of Life & General Improvements[/b][/i]

- Localization for Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, and Spanish have been added
- Removed the downsides from Creature Perks
[i]We've received very consistent feedback regarding creature perks feeling so punishing that most players simply decided to not interact with them. While removing the downsides will alleviate this, it does remove some diversity in decisions around selecting perks, and it should be a core RPG element that is embraced, exciting, and interesting. We'll be revisiting creature perks to revamp the experience in greater detail.[/i]

- Added the ability to rename Blank from the Title Screen.
[i]We hear you, not only is Blank's name confusing, players should be able to choose their name. To be clear, we'll be pushing an update with character customization, and choosing a name for your character from the beginning of a new game/save is how it should, and will be.
We didn't want everyone to have to wait for that update to change their name, so for now we introduced a name change available to each save on the main menu. On any existing save slot, there is an Icon next to your save slot that will allow you to change your name!
To reiterate: For now, changing your name isn't accessible immediately from starting a new game/save, this will be revamped when character customization is ready![/i]



To be transparent, we really wanted to launch with Localization, but it wasn't ready, and now after addressing the sneakiest bugs, and bringing a number of updates to the game overall, we had some time to get Localization where it needed to be. There will be some remaining sneaky bugs we'll need help catching with Localization, so if you see any let us know and we'll take care of them! We sincerely thank everyone who has waited so patiently for Localization. 
We've also been working on a roadmap for Creature Keeper behind the scenes, and will share it with everyone when we're confident it's ready. 

Lastly, if you've enjoyed Creature Keeper, or would like to support it's continued development, leaving a positive steam review helps so much. We're always listening, and this game will continue to be a labor of love for a long time.

Indie forever,
Zach

notes.title: Menu Improvements, Bug Fixes & Quality of Life
notes.content:
Another batch of updates for the Keepers of Thera! With our fourth patch, we wanted to push our first round of menu improvements, squash more bugs, and bring some much needed Quality of Life to multiple areas of Creature Keeper.

We're excited to share some exciting news with you coming soon as well, and while I can't quite spill the beans yet, it'll be a big step forward for Creature Keeper!


[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

- Fixed a cutscene in Act4 where talking to an NPC would trigger a battle scene from earlier in the game
- Fixed a softlock where you could travel backwards after the final fight which would result in a white screen
- Fixed a source of Pocket Garden lag which was caused by an event continuously being retriggered, which would force the game to redraw seeds in the garden
- Fixed another source of  Pocket Garden lag caused by multiple instances of your Bottom Right HUD being drawn for each creature that was spawned when you entered PG
- Fixed a bug which was preventing your cursor from moving on the title screen
- Fixed notifications in Bestiary to stop when you've fully completed an entry
- Fixed Creature Name text in party menu overlapping Skill Gem Popup text
- Removed an item that was spawning when Sabi destroyed a plant in a cutscene
- Added extra button prompts to some menus to indicate what button closes the menu
- Fixed Creature Names being displayed over Skill Gem popups


[i][b]Quality of Life & General Improvements[/b][/i]

- Rearranged Pocket Garden elements to make it easier to move around the menu
[i]When you select a Creature Tile or Seed Tile, the cursor automatically moves to the center of the Pocket Garden[/i]

- Tweaked how the cursor selects boxes in Pocket Garden
- Added Bumper and Trigger Support in Party menu to aid with selecting creatures and switching tabs respectively
- Added Trigger Support when interacting with the Summoning Stone to aid with finding creatures more quickly
- Added Trigger Support when interacting with Pocket Garden to navigate between seeds more easily
- Added Trigger Support when navigating the Bestiary
- Added Trigger Support for the tips screen to help with navigation
- Added a rebind option for Menu Left.
[i]Options to rebind Menu Right, Menu Left 2, and Menu Right 2 are coming soon![/i]

[i]This initial pass with trigger and bumper support was made with controllers in mind. Keybinds that will help both controllers and keyboards especially is on its way soon![/i]

- Updated art on pause screen
- Updated art on the party screen
- Replaced an asset in the final scene
- Added close button prompts in Bestiary
- Added prompts in Pocket Garden Screen for creature management
- Adjusted button prompts to show only on the left when hovering over Creature Tiles at the top and in the Pocket Garden itself
- Added button prompts to the title screen


We're looking to add much more quality of life, fix up the remaining stickiness in certain menu navigation areas, take a look at creature perks, and many more as we go into the latter half of May. We hope you've all been enjoying the Creature Collector Steam Fest! More updates coming soon.

Indie forever,
Zach

notes.title: More Bug Fixes & General Improvements
notes.content:
A fresh patch arrives today, and will be our third since Creature Keeper launched on May 8th. While there is still much work to be done, we're in the zone, and are listening closely to all channels for feedback on improving Creature Keeper.


[i][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/i]

- Fixed a softlock related to a warp after an event in Act3
- Changed the pathing in Horn Tower which was causing some softlocks to occur when warping out from the top of the tower
- Prevented an Act3 cutscene from triggering in the wrong spot
- Fixed an issue where lore text from the Act2 dungeon wasn't displaying at all

- Added a scene that was missing where Max Command was increased to 3
*If you were affected by this bug and don't have a Max Command of 3 when you are supposed to, loading your game will fix the issue*

- Fixed softlock caused by dying during the Elemental fight with Millienne
*If you were affected by this bug, it should be fixed upon loading your save*

- Fixed softlock where NPCs in your party were disappearing when finishing Gruff's side quest
*If you were affected by this bug, it should be fixed upon loading your save*

- Fixed some softlocks related to talking to certain NPCS (Millienne and T'Dao) after starting Act2's questline, which would break saves
*Those who have been affected by this bug will have your save restored upon loading the game*


[i][b]General Improvements[/b][/i]

- Pocket Garden prompt picture was incorrect when the player was asked to plant a seed next to a creature
- Pocket Gardent tutorial explanations were changed to be more clear and less wordy
- Fixed a blocked path in the Protestor Camp
- Disabled placing a hat found in a treasure chest directly onto a creature (this does not mean hats equipped to creatures from the party screen is disabled)
- Removed Lutras from displaying on the Sodland World Map Creature Tracker
- Fixed some Missing map and item names
- When you close Befriending screen, prompts now immediately disappear
- Updated some button icons which were incorrectly being shown, related to the Befriending screen
- Removed a mention of a recipe from Sulao's quest
- Adjusted hitbox of the pedestal in The Elysis
- Removed Interaction from pedestal in The Elysis (no dialogue)
- Replaced a sprite in the epilogue



We appreciate all the feedback we've received for Creature Keeper, we're listening, and working hard. More updates coming soon.

Indie forever,
Zach

notes.title: Improved Tutorial Support & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Our first round of bug fixes and improvements, with many more to come.[/h2]


[b][i]Bug fixes:[/i][/b]

- Fixed softlock in Act 3 where you could miss a warp, and if you died you couldn't get back to be able to complete the story
Users affected by this softlock will have a fix applied whenever they try to fast travel from a Traveler's Stone

- Fixed softlock in Act 4 where you could talk to Bibb in Bibb's Sanctuary and overwrite Act4 Progress
Users affected by this softlock will have a fix applied when they Go to the Horn Tower



[i][b]Improvements:[/b][/i]

- "Add Fruit" prompt in Befriending screen has been updated to include the right button icon

- Added a sign that shows where Selias and Sodland Inn are shortly after completing the tutorial

- Added button prompts to the intro tutorial, to show which buttons to press when the game pauses during these tutorial sequences: 
1. The first dialogue sequence at the start of the game
2. dodge tutorial
3. Perception Mode tutorial

- Added button prompts to the perception mode tutorial, to show what buttons to press when the player needs to pet, or activate their 'make-believe' creature's skill gem

- Increased player damage by 500%. 
This may seem like an over-adjustment, but Blank's innate damage doesn't scale as hard as creature damage. So while this will help players feel more agency in the pacing & overall interactive qualities of combat, your creatures should still feel impactful. This should especially help smooth out the experience at the start of the game before you obtain the ability to have more than one creature active at once, and before your creature has time to level up and become stronger.
Lastly, because creatures dealt significantly more damage than the player, relying on creature AI was a frustrating experience, and it wasn't fun to interact with.


While any remaining bugs that are preventing or hindering progression are our top priority, it's important to us to address what makes the game not fun to play. We have plenty more to work on, such as general controls, menu navigation and save options.

Thank you for supporting Creature Keeper, more updates coming soon,
Zach

notes.title: Known Bugs & Issues with Creature Keeper Launch Build
notes.content:
This list is comprised of bugs & issues we've collected throughout launch day. Such that players know we are going to address them first and foremost, and we communicate issues that may have affected players, or may in the future. 


[i][b]Known Bugs[/b][/i]

- If you befriend a Denka into your party or storage before interacting with the first pocket garden sequence, which happens once you first arrive at Horn Tower, it will break the sequence. 
[b]This bug has been fixed internally, and will be patched asap[/b]

- Some players when launching the game cannot navigate the options or menus with their controller until they return to use their keyboard. Which then allows navigation for controllers. 

- There are some sneaky sequence breaks existing specifically for content at the end of the game

- A few players are starting their game with default keybinds unbound

- In very rare cases players are experiencing saving issues, the only cases of this we've seen so far are with losing save 2 or 3 to save 1

- Miscellaneous bugs that may not hinder the gameplay experience much individually, but may collectively


[i][b]Current Issues[/b][/i]

- Player damage is too low when compared to creatures, and makes for non-interactive combat pacing at the beginning of the game

- Navigating menus with controllers is inconsistent when trying to move certain directions in certain menus

- Keyboard controls need improvement, in addition to keyboard prompts

- Playing Creature Keeper on Ultrawide is causing consistent crashes

- Tutorial sections involving dodging out of the way of Aren, and after the first battle with Aren are causing confusion, and are more unintuitive than we intended. The game is waiting for the correct inputs, but is being mistaken for freezing in most cases. 
We are looking into short term solutions for this until it can be either be better instructed, or redesigned to prevent confusion.

- The "Black screen" sequence intro at very beginning of the game is causing confusion, especially with keyboard users, when there is not a prompt of which button to press to continue the sequence. 

- Localization will be coming to Creature Keeper

- There is not enough visual feedback on when the game is saving. It saves every time you walk near a fast travel location and/or crystal. There is an icon in the bottom left of the screen when this occurs.



We are dedicated to making Creature Keeper the best game it can be, please keep your feedback & bug reports coming. We're watching, listening, and iterating. If there is something we missed in this list, let us know! 

Indie forever,
Zach
